@font-face {
  font-family: "Optimistic";

  font-weight: 400 600;
  font-display: swap;

}
:where(code, pre, kbd, samp) {

}

        :root{--bg:#f6f8f5;--cd:#fff;--tx:#1b2a22;--mu:#5d6b63;--bd:#dce3dd;--ac:#1f7a52;--a2:#e3f1ea;--wr:#b4531a;--bad:#a63232;--ok:#1f7a52;--shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(27,42,34,0.06), 0 6px 18px rgba(27,42,34,0.04)}
        @media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#101814;--cd:#18231d;--tx:#e6efe9;--mu:#9bafa4;--bd:#2a3a31;--ac:#4cc58a;--a2:#1d3328;--wr:#e69a62;--bad:#e57a7a;--ok:#4cc58a}}
        *{box-sizing:border-box}
        body{margin:0}
        .font-display{font-family:"Fraunces", Georgia, serif}
        .font-body{font-family:"Instrument Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif}
        .card{background:var(--cd);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
        .pill{display:inline-block;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--a2);color:var(--ac);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.02em}
        .pill.H{background:transparent;color:var(--bad);border:1px solid var(--bad)}.pill.M{background:transparent;color:var(--wr);border:1px solid var(--wr)}
        .bar{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--bd);overflow:hidden}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--ac)}
        .hide{display:none}
        select,input[type=number],input[type=text],textarea{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font:inherit;transition:border-color .15s}
        select:focus,input:focus,textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--ac);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--a2)}
        .chk{display:flex;gap:8px;font-weight:400;margin:6px 0;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}.chk input{margin-top:4px;accent-color:var(--ac)}
        .g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}@media(max-width:640px){.g2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
